title: Transfinitely iterated wild sets
summary: In this paper, we study homotopical analogues of the Cantor-Bendixson derivative. For each $n\geq 0$, the "$π_n$-wild set" $\mathbf{w}_n(X)$ of a topological space $X$ is the subspace of $X$ consisting of the points at which there exists a shrinking sequence of essential based maps $S^n\to X$. Since the operator $\mathbf{w}_n$ permits iteration, every given space $X$ yields a descending transfinite sequence of nested subspaces $\{\mathbf{w}_n^κ(X)\}_κ$ that stabilizes at some smallest ordinal $\mathbf{wrk}_n(X)$ called the "$π_n$-wild rank" of $X$.
